:::{#def-dtime}
#### Time complexity class

Let $T$ be a function from the nonnegative integers to the positive real numbers.
The class $\text{DTIME}(T(n))$ is the set of [decision problems](p-and-np.qmd#def-decision-problem)
$L$ such that some [Turing machine](models-of-computation.qmd#def-turing-machine)
[decides](models-of-computation.qmd#def-tm-computes) $L$ and [runs in time](p-and-np.qmd#def-running-time) $T'(n)$
for some function $T'$ with $T'(n) = \asymub{T(n)}$
([big-O notation](asymptotic-notation.qmd#def-big-o)).
@arora2009computational [section 1.6] require a [running time](p-and-np.qmd#def-running-time) of at most $c \, T(n)$ for a constant $c$ and every $n$.
Because $T(n) > 0$, the two definitions agree:
a larger $c$ covers the finitely many $n$ below the threshold of $\asymub{\cdot}$.

:::
